subagent_strategy.trigger: The target carries a load-bearing governance-vs-ergonomics tension plus hidden element/property/flow structure; role-bound siblings with opposed vectors reduce single-perspective bias before parent synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three reviewers run during the interrogation/design stages: an ergonomics advocate pushing maximal Figma freedom, a governance-integrity skeptic defending the honest diff and component model, and an implementation-cost realist grounding what is buildable on the node/fastify/preview-server stack. Roles 1 and 2 are deliberately opposed (anti-bias axis: ergonomic-freedom <-> governed-integrity); role 3 supplies the cost vector. Refine remains orchestrator and synthesizes; subagents return receipts only.
context: Selected overlays (dialectic, x-ray, route_menu) drive this role set.
Subagents return receipts; they do not own lifecycle promotion.
Execution waits for operator approval after dispatch validation.

roles.purpose: Argue for maximal Figma-like freedom: hover any element, frictionless inline form, batch freely, expand/collapse anywhere. Ergonomics is the first principle.
Defend the honest per-component diff, data-od-id model, append-only manifest, and auditability. Attack any freeform/theme path that makes the diff lie or breaks two-gate approval.
Bound the design to what is buildable for an MVP on node + fastify + the no-build preview server: computed-style extraction feasibility, stable element addressing, view-state, and test/e2e impact.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Dispatch Spec recommends three role-bound reviewers (ergonomics-advocate, governance-integrity-skeptic, implementation-cost-realist) during the interrogation/design stages. Run these delegated reviewers before native runtime-backed stages?
